subject: Audit logs & evidence request — post-call recap (FinCo)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@finco.com>, Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@finco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Audit logs & evidence request — post-call recap (FinCo)

Hi Julia / Mike,

Thanks again for your time today — appreciate the thoughtful questions on data access and auditability. Quick recap of what we discussed and the next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Scope: you wanted details on audit logs covering who accessed customer data (user/service), which dataset/record/field was accessed, timestamp, and the action performed (read/export/delete).
- Export formats: we showed CSV and Parquet examples; can stream to S3 or push to a secure syslog/SIEM.
- Retention: Redwood’s default audit retention is 12 months for hosted logs; Dedicated/Private can be configured per-customer (we support 30/90/365/indefinite).
- PII flagging: our runtime tags PII at ingestion and stores access metadata separately; we can include a PII boolean per log line in exports.
- Residency: logs for Hosted customers are stored in the region of the deployment (us-east-1 / eu-west-1) — we can push exports only to allowed regions.
- Evidence & artifacts: attaching a small sample audit log export and our SOC 2 summary for reference.

Attachments:
- audit_logs_sample.csv (sample schema: timestamp, actor_type, actor_id, dataset, field, action, pii_flag, request_id)
- SOC2_report_redwood_2025.pdf (summary page)

Next steps / asks from FinCo:
1) Confirm required retention window (e.g., 365 days) and if you need immutable retention/export (WORM).
2) Confirm export destination (S3 bucket ARN OR SIEM endpoint) and preferred format (CSV/Parquet).
3) Let us know if you need field-level proof (e.g., hashed values vs raw) when showing PII access.

I’ve looped in Marissa (security/product) — she can provide an example export and coordinate a short follow-up with engineering if you want a live walk-through of an export.

If it helps I can also open a HubSpot ticket and attach the full security questionnaire so we can track deliverables.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

--
Attachment: audit_logs_sample.csv (text/csv, stub 145KB)
Attachment: SOC2_report_redwood_2025.pdf (application/pdf, stub 420KB)

From: Julia Park <julia.park@finco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Audit logs & evidence request — post-call recap (FinCo)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the clear summary — that helps. A few clarifying questions from our security/compliance side: 

1) For the field-level access: can the audit log tell us which exact field names were accessed (e.g., ssn, email, phone) or do you only log dataset/table-level reads? We need evidence that PII fields were accessed and who did it.
2) For retention: we need 2 years of logs with the ability to lock them for 1 year (WORM) for a subsection of audit data. Is that configurable on Hosted, or would we need Dedicated/Private?
3) Exports: our compliance team prefers Parquet pushed to an S3 bucket in us-east-1 with bucket policies enforced by our cloud team. Do you support cross-account deliveries?

Also: can you provide a sample of the schema with the pii_flag populated (you attached a sample but it looked redacted). If you can provide a PEG (procedural evidence guide) or simple example of ‘who/what/when’ for an access event that would help speed our internal review.

Thanks — cc’ing Mike (infra) for bucket specifics and Marissa for security follow-up.

Best,
Julia
Senior Security Analyst | FinCo Capital
julia.park@finco.com

--
On Sun, 01 Mar 2026 at 15:12, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> (see above)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@finco.com>, Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@finco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit logs & evidence request — post-call recap (FinCo)

Hi Julia — great questions, answered inline below. I’ll schedule a short call if helpful after you review.

1) Field-level access: Yes — our audit schema can record field-level access. The sample we attached was redacted for the public copy; attached here is an expanded CSV sample with pii_flag values and an example where field_name="ssn_hashed" was read. We record: timestamp, actor_type (user/service), actor_id (email or service id), dataset, table, field_name, action, pii_flag, request_id, region.

2) Retention & WORM: Hosted customers default to 12 months retention. We can extend to 24 months for hosted but WORM (immutable retention) requires Dedicated or Private deployments due to storage controls and customer-managed keys. If you need a contractual WORM requirement we would recommend Dedicated.

3) Exports / cross-account S3: We support cross-account S3 delivery via presigned PUT or cross-account role assumption. We can push Parquet to your us-east-1 bucket and restrict delivery to that ARN. We will work with your cloud team on the exact principal and bucket policy.

Peg / evidence example: see the attached snippet (audit_logs_sample_expanded.csv) which shows an access event row and an explanation: 
- request_id: a UUID to trace the API call
- actor_id: j.parker@finco.com (example)
- field_name: ssn_hashed
- pii_flag: true
- action: read
- timestamp: 2026-02-28T22:14:07Z

Next steps I propose: 
- I’ll attach the expanded CSV sample and a short PEG doc outlining how to interpret rows (who/what/when mapping).
- Marissa — can you confirm if we can provide a Hosted 24-month retention for this customer as a temporary accommodation while we scope Dedicated?
- Julia / Mike — can you share the target S3 ARN (or the CIAM principal) and confirm if Parquet is preferred?

If it helps, we can also set up a 30-minute live export demo (engineer on the call) — available Tue/Wed this week.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Attachment: audit_logs_sample_expanded.csv (text/csv, stub 520KB)
Attachment: PEG_audit_logs_short.pdf (application/pdf, stub 95KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@finco.com>, Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@finco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit logs & evidence request — post-call recap (FinCo)

Hi all,

Thanks for the detailed notes, Rishi. Quick answers from security/product: 

- Hosted 24-month retention: we can offer 24 months for Hosted as a time-limited support accommodation and will log the agreement in HubSpot (contact Rishi for the limit). For contractual WORM we require Dedicated/Private.
- Cross-account S3 delivery: supported; we will need the target ARN and the principal (IAM role) that Redwood should assume. We will provide a sample bucket policy and CloudTrail mapping.
- Field-level evidence: see the expanded CSV attached — it contains sample pii_flag=true rows and the mapping table in the PEG document. For higher assurance we can include a hash of the exact field value in the log (salted) if you need tamper-evidence without storing raw PII.

I’ll follow up with a short engineering note that documents the export API (signed URL flow) and the expected permissions. Rishi — I added a short note in the HubSpot deal (FIN-2026-0042) and assigned a follow-up to Ben to coordinate the demo.

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Security Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
